articles.title: Luis Robert Jr., Orioles Agree On One-Year, $12M Deal
articles.description: Free agent outfielder Luis Robert Jr. is in agreement to return to the Baltimore Orioles on a one-year, $12 million contract, sources told ESPN's Jeff Passan on Wednesday. The Orioles claimed Robert off waivers from the New York Mets on Aug. 31 but he appeared in just three games for Baltimore before landing on the injured list with hamstring issues. The team declined his $20 million club option for 2027, but it's now set to bring him back for less.
